scope: Selected variants only. Each supported variant runs in an isolated native process. Synchronous and Promise-job asynchronous Scripts with parsed strictness; harness sources unchanged in their own Script modes. Parse-negative tests use the native JavaScript parser without evaluation. Module execution, agents, parser limitations and missing syntax/runtime operations remain unsupported. Harness paths requiring missing builtins may fail. No whole-suite coverage claim.

compilation.failurePolicy: A failed batch compilation is retained for every affected variant; no automatic retry.
